ns2:section.sectionText: Title: American New Music c.1965-1995 A seminar looking at several strains of uniquely American contributions to new music during this period. Extensive listening with supporting reading and analysis. Topics will include: New York School (late works by Feldman and Cage); Minimalism/PostMinimalism; New York City “Downtown” composed and improvised music; AACM (Chicago) composed and improvised music; and other. Prerequisite: MUS 502B or a pass on graduate theory entrance exam, or consent of instructor. To have taken 408E is helpful, but not required. Can be taken for 2 or 3 credit hours. 3 hours requires larger final project.
